user.title: Connect to the Intergas Xtend
user.description: The Home Assistant host must be joined to the Wi-Fi access point of the Xtend. Polling also keeps that access point awake.

data_description.host: IP address of the Xtend on its own access point, usually 10.20.30.1.
data_description.scan_interval: How often the status is read, between 5 and 60 seconds.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Xtend. Check that the access point is on and that this host is joined to it.
error.invalid_response: The device answered, but not with the expected status payload. Check the host.
